bear_assumptions: USD 2.60 EPS at 24x; orders and margins normalize, transaction costs weigh on per-share earnings, and indicative net debt rises from USD 2.320 billion to about USD 3.02 billion after the USD 5.5 billion Rotork price less USD 4.8 billion Robotics proceeds before fees and closing adjustments.
base_assumptions: USD 3.10 EPS at 28x; operating growth continues from annualized first-half basic EPS of USD 2.82, but Robotics leaves the group and Rotork integration consumes capital across approximately 1.815 billion outstanding shares.
bull_assumptions: USD 3.50 EPS at 30x; positive book-to-bill, 20% class margins and cash conversion persist, the Robotics disposal and Rotork acquisition close near disclosed terms, and integration avoids material dilution or balance-sheet strain.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a lower price or stronger primary evidence on transaction-adjusted EPS, disposal proceeds, Rotork integration, net debt and retained automation economics clears expected-return, base-return, downside-payoff and margin-of-safety gates; downgrade the operating thesis if orders, margins, cash conversion, acquisition returns or balance-sheet capacity weaken.
